capsuleTopic.title: Angels
capsuleTopic.subtitle: Sent · speaking · guiding · judging · worshiping · contending
capsuleTopic.orientation: Trace what Scripture explicitly says angels do, where they appear, whom they serve, and which identity questions the sources leave open.
capsuleTopic.trailPrompt: Follow angelic sending, speech, recognition, guidance, judgment, worship, service, mediation, and conflict without merging distinct Scripture categories.
